desktop.subtitle: Manage how the app looks, your language and your account security.
desktop.appearanceHint: Choose a light or dark look, or follow your device.
desktop.languageHint: Pick the language of the app. Course content stays in English.
desktop.aboutHint: Information about this app and the account you are signed in with.
desktop.securityHint: Two-step verification, your password and the devices signed in to your account.
desktop.setupHint: Link an authenticator app, then enter the code it shows.

twoFactor.title: Two-step verification
twoFactor.description: Ask for a code from your authenticator app every time you log in, on top of your password.
twoFactor.lowRecovery: You are running low. Generate new recovery codes before you lose access.

setup.title: Set up two-step verification
setup.step1Body: Open an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, Authy...) and scan this code.
setup.qrLabel: QR code to scan with your authenticator app
setup.manual: Can't scan? Enter this key in the app
setup.step2Body: Type the code the app shows to confirm that it works.

recovery.title: Save your recovery codes
recovery.warning: Each code works once and lets you log in if you lose your phone. They are shown only now - store them somewhere safe.

disable.title: Turn off two-step verification
disable.warning: Your account will only be protected by your password.

regenerate.title: Get new recovery codes
regenerate.warning: Your old recovery codes stop working as soon as new ones are created.

password.title: Password
password.description: Change the password you use to log in. Your other devices will be logged out.
password.sameAsCurrent: The new password must be different from the current one
password.success: Password updated. Your other devices were logged out.

devices.title: Devices
devices.description: Where you are logged in. Log out of any device you don't recognize.
devices.confirmMessage: {{name}} will be logged out right away.
devices.confirmOthersMessage: Every device except this one will be logged out.
devices.noOthers: You are not logged in anywhere else.
